newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dalian Friendship to launch A shares.
newsitem.headline: Dalian Friendship to launch A shares.

text.p: Dalian Friendship (Group) Co Ltd said on Friday it will launch an initial public offering of 35 million A shares on the Shenzhen bourse on December 26.
The offer, approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, has been priced at 9.80 yuan per share, a prospectus published in the Shenzhen Special Zone Daily said.
Pingan Securities Co Ltd has been appointed the offer's lead underwriter, it said.
The company operates a five-star hotel in the coastal city of Dalian in northeastern Liaoning province and is also involved in retail operations.
The offer is expected to raise a net income of 329 million yuan, excluding the issue cost, and proceeds will be used to expand the firm's hotel and retail business, the prospectus said.

The company forecast post-tax profits of 63 million yuan for 1996, compared with 54.27 million yuan for 1995 and 55.21 million yuan a year earlier, it said, adding that the firm had booked after-tax profits of 48.13 million yuan for the first nine months of this year.

After the offer, the firm will have a total of 110 million outstanding shares with A shares accounting for 31.81 percent apart from 60 million state shares and 15 million employee shares, the prospectus said.
